title: Turning Show Unassigned on adds a single Unassigned row pinned to the top and recomputes the grand Totals
preconditions: 1. Matching unassigned invoices exist; the grand Totals with the toggle off are noted.
steps: 1. Turn "Show Unassigned" on and read the new row and its position.
expected: 1. A single summary row labeled "Unassigned" (verbatim) rolls up every matching invoice that has no assigned rep, respecting all other active filters.
2. The row is pinned to the TOP of the table, above the A→Z reps, and stays pinned regardless of sort.
3. Toggling re-renders the report and recomputes the grand Totals to include or exclude the Unassigned row accordingly.
